changes.comment: ai-assist: provider server-tool/client-tool exclusions are now declared on the descriptor (IAiProviderDescriptor.serverToolsExclusiveWithClientTools) and resolved generically by resolveToolConflicts, instead of being a hard failure keyed on apiFormat === 'gemini'. executeClientToolTurn takes toolConflictPolicy ('drop-server-tools' default | 'prefer-server-tools' | 'fail') and its result carries a required toolConflicts report naming what was dropped. Behavior change: a Gemini turn combining web_search with client tools now succeeds with web_search dropped where it previously failed; pass toolConflictPolicy: 'fail' for the old behavior. IAiClientToolTurnResult gains the required toolConflicts member. The tool types move to a new ai-assist/toolTypes module, re-exported from model, so no import path changes.
